source:
@@U03301@@
Stay with her awhile; she'll cure you
with her knowledge of herbs, I assure you.

@@U03303@@
Cure? I don’t want to be cured!
My mind is sound!
I will zot be one of the common herd!

@@U03305@@
Don't fail to drink at the healing spring.
Hurry! Dismount! We're at the site!

@@U03307@@
Where have you brought me in this
dreadful night through gravelly waters?

@@U03309@@
This is where Rome and Greece met in battle.
珀涅俄斯河 on the right,
奥林匹斯山 on the left,
and the greatest empire sunk into the sand.
The king fled, the citizens won.
Look up!
Behold the eternal temple
bathed in moonlight!

@@U03311@@
(Dreaming within.)

@@U03312@@
The sacred threshold
resounds with horse’s hoofs;
demigods draw near.

@@U03314@@
How true!
Only open your eyes.

@@U03316@@
(Awaking.)

@@U03317@@
Welcome!
I see you haven't failed me.
translation:
@@U03301@@
陪她一会儿；她会治愈你的
以她对草药的了解，我向你保证。

@@U03303@@
治愈？我不想被治愈！
我的头脑很清醒！
我将成为普通人群中的一员！

@@U03305@@
不要错过喝疗愈泉水的机会。
匆忙！下马！我们到了现场！

@@U03307@@
你把我带到哪里了
穿过砾石水域的可怕夜晚？

@@U03309@@
这是罗马和希腊交战的地方。
珀涅俄斯河在右边，
左边是奥林匹斯山，
和最伟大的帝国沉入沙中。
国王逃跑了，公民获胜了。
抬头！
看那永恒的圣殿
沐浴在月光下！

@@U03311@@
（内心做梦。）

@@U03312@@
神圣的门槛
马蹄声回响；
半神临近。

@@U03314@@
多么真实啊！
只要睁开眼睛。

@@U03316@@
（醒来。）

@@U03317@@
欢迎！
我看你没有让我失望。
